meta.name: District-wise area, production and yield of major crops, 2022-23
meta.source_org: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (APY portal)
meta.limitations: Source reports 2022-23 district totals from the states. Some states report few districts or leave crops blank (null). New districts (for example in Andhra Pradesh after 2022) do not exist in data/ref/districts2020.csv and are not joined; see data/meta/crop_district.md. Cotton production is in bales of 170 kg. 'cereals' and 'foodgrains' are source totals that include crops not in this file.
meta.method: fetch_apy.py posts the portal query forms (per state; crops rice, wheat, maize, cotton, sugarcane; groups cereals, pulses, foodgrains, oilseeds). build_crop_district.py parses the HTML tables, joins on normalised district names within state (exact, then difflib ratio >= 0.9), and computes yield = production / area.
